not_from_upstream.$comment: Present here but not in the upstream tree at this commit. These are herdr's own repo furniture, moved under backend/ on 2026-09-11 so it stops competing with Osade's at the repo root (PRD-DELTA #14).

relationship_to_the_shipped_binary: This source is AHEAD of the binary Osade runs. vendor/herdr/0.8.2-p20 pins the v0.8.2 release, whose checksum is recorded and verified. Source and binary are pinned to different things, deliberately: the binary is the contract, the source explains its behaviour.
